interpretation.PASS: The frozen prospective cohort meets the preregistered sample, completeness, evidence, integrity, no-effect and observed-stratum coverage criteria. This authorizes only a separate offline baseline comparison.
interpretation.FAIL: A falsification or integrity condition is met. Training remains blocked until a separately reviewed corrective path is completed.
interpretation.CONTINUE-COLLECTING: The cohort is structurally admissible but lacks preregistered sample, completeness or coverage sufficiency. Training remains blocked and thresholds must not be relaxed post hoc.
